sources.title: BananaMind-2-MoE - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BananaMind-2-MoE is a sparse decoder-only causal language model trained from scratch by BananaMind on a 30B-token curriculum. The model has 25,086,592 total parameters, approximately 1,985,152 active parameters per token, a 4,096-token context window, and a custom 8k-token digit-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer.
